comment: Communities/districts along the Airport→Kingston→Bog Walk→Fern Gully→Ocho Rios route. Lat/lon from OSM. Entries marked needs_owner_review require the owner's lived knowledge to confirm. Ordering follows the drive direction.

communities.name: Norman Manley International Airport
communities.note: Route start — international gateway to Jamaica

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: Narrow tombolo strip — sea on both sides, iconic coconut trees lining the road

communities.name: Port Royal
communities.note: Historic pirate city — signpost from the Palisadoes; route does not enter

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout where potholes begin; junction for Port Morant road east

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial area along Windward Road; Rockfort Mineral Bath nearby

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Rastafari hillside community overlooking Kingston Harbour

communities.name: Arnett Gardens
communities.note: Inner-city community; known locally as Jungle

communities.name: Kingston Downtown
communities.note: Commercial heart — National Heroes Park, Kingston Waterfront, historic squares

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Financial and hotel district; Emancipation Park, Devon House nearby

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The transport hub of Jamaica — clock tower, market, constant gridlock

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major intersection linking uptown and downtown Kingston

communities.name: Havendale
communities.note: Residential suburb west of Half Way Tree

communities.name: Spanish Town Road Corridor
communities.note: Main artery heading west out of Kingston toward Spanish Town

communities.name: Six Miles
communities.note: Junction community; named for its distance from old Kingston centre

communities.name: Caymanas
communities.note: Sugarcane plain and Caymanas Park racetrack — horse racing is serious business here

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Historic colonial capital of Jamaica; Cathedral, Iron Bridge, Rodney Memorial

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: One-lane bridge over the Rio Cobre — famous flood spot at the Bog Walk gorge entrance

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gorge community in the Rio Cobre valley; dramatic limestone cliffs

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Alumina plant town; marks the climb out of the gorge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous market town — 'Linstead Market' folk song; bustling on Saturdays

communities.name: Riversdale
communities.note: Small farming community on the climb to Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Cool hill-country crossroads; famous for goats on the road

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Rural mountain community; wrong-turn off-road option in-game

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival; legendary rest stop

communities.name: Moneague College
communities.note: Community college serving the interior parishes

communities.name: Alexandria
communities.note: Small St. Ann community on the descent toward Fern Gully

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: 3 km canopy tunnel — hundreds of fern species, bamboo arching overhead; one of Jamaica's most iconic drives

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist hub on the north coast; route ends at Dunn's River Falls

communities.name: Dunn's River Falls
communities.note: Route terminus — climb the famous cascading falls, then the bath finale
